description:
About the Position

Twente is recruiting two PhD researchers within Moore4Power to improve measurements of fast-switching power electronics. One direction develops current sensors; the other studies traceable converter-efficiency measurement. This PhD opening at University of Twente centres on Measuring the Future of Power Electronics: Two PhD Positions at Twente, Netherlands. The work sits within Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering. The host institution is in Enschede, Netherlands. According to the listing, the opportunity is fully funded; financial support is listed as €3,204–€4,051 gross/month, increasing with doctoral year.. The stated deadline is Before 6 November 2026.

Research Position Overview

Choose sensor design and validation, or electrical/calorimetric loss measurement. Both directions involve experiments with SiC/GaN devices and collaboration with European project partners. This PhD opening at University of Twente centres on Measuring the Future of Power Electronics: Two PhD Positions at Twente, Netherlands. Research areas covered include Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering. The role is based in Enschede, Netherlands. Full funding is provided; financial support is listed as €3,204–€4,051 gross/month, increasing with doctoral year.. Applications close Before 6 November 2026.

Research Areas

  • Wideband current sensors
  • Power-converter metrology
  • Electrical and thermal efficiency measurement

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Before 6 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

  • Motivation letter stating PhD 1, PhD 2 or both.
  • Detailed CV, BSc/MSc transcripts, two reference contacts and publications if applicable.

Submit through the application button on the official recruitment page.

Selection and Contact

One recruitment advert covers two positions; this batch counts the advert once.

Project contact: Professor Gert Rietveld or Professor Thiago Batista Soeiro.

About University of Twente

The project combines Twente’s measurement and power-electronics research with expertise from VSL, the Dutch National Metrology Institute.
